title: Contents Packout & Storage Declared-Value Coverage Facility Schedule
content:
Contents Packout & Storage declared-value coverage follows the company's coverage facility schedule by the policy state on the job's linked claim file. For the coverage of a Partial Contents Packout or Full Contents Packout job, **a policy state of FL carries the Florida coverage factor, a policy state of LA carries the Louisiana coverage factor, and any other policy state, or a job with no linked claim file, carries a coverage factor of one.**

| Policy state on the linked Insurance Claim Services claim file | Coverage factor |
|---|---|
| FL | 1.12 |
| LA | 1.06 |
| any other state | 1 |
| no linked claim file | 1 |

The state is the policy state recorded on the claim file the contents job is linked to.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A coverage figure of 50.00 before the factor becomes 56.00 under a Florida claim file, 53.00 under a Louisiana claim file and stays 50.00 under a Georgia claim file or on a self-pay job with no claim file.
